notes: Workspace templates (user-data-separation uds/C5, uds/F). templates/workspace/ is what a new install copies into an empty data folder (uds/D); templates/dev-workspace/ holds the dev build's own files, tracked because an install's workspace is user data outside the repo. 'same' = shipped as is (one copy, in templates/workspace); 'variant' = the shipped copy differs on purpose and the dev copy is in templates/dev-workspace; 'not_shipped' = dev-workspace only, with the reason (its role packs are defaults the dev build copies in once: role packs are user data, art and dev alike); 'per_install' = this user's or this host's own file, in neither template. tests/test_workspace_template.py enforces it.

variant.team.json: empty roster until the premade pack is chosen (uds C3)

not_shipped.DEV-CHARTER.md: the dev build's own rules, injected after the shipped charter only when CHATBOT_EDITION=dev (DEV_SPLIT_v1)
not_shipped.PROJECT.md: engine code map for the dev role (pew/L)
not_shipped.roles/dev/ROLE.md: engine work role (dev build only, pew/L)
not_shipped.roles/dev/PROCEDURE.md: engine work role (dev build only, pew/L)
not_shipped.roles/lead/ROLE.md: delegation role; delegate is not in the shipped build (edition-boundary)
not_shipped.roles/lead/PROCEDURE.md: delegation role; delegate is not in the shipped build (edition-boundary)
not_shipped.roles/plan/ROLE.md: delegated planning role; delegate is not in the shipped build (edition-boundary)
not_shipped.roles/scout/ROLE.md: market & trend scouting role (dev build only)
not_shipped.roles/scout/PROCEDURE.md: market & trend scouting procedure (dev build only)
not_shipped..agents/skills/character-art/SKILL.md: runs engine-repo tools and host paths; waits for edition E (user-facing tool route)
runs engine-repo tools and host paths; waits for edition E (user-facing tool route)

not_shipped..agents/skills/progress-report/SKILL.md: lead skill: reports from handoffs, dms and tickets (dev build only)
